name: waveform_peaks
description: Emit min/max audio peak pairs at a fixed samples-per-second resolution, for a scrubbable waveform view. Mono mixdown; total pairs clamped to 500k per call.

input.description: Source video or audio file (use 'inputs' for batch parallel processing)

output.description: {samplesPerSecond, start, duration, peaks:[min,max,min,max,...]}. Batch mode returns an array of these.

params.name: samples-per-second
params.description: Peak pairs per second: 50, 200 or 800 (another takes the nearest, said in a note). Stepped down if over the 500k-pair clamp.

params.name: start
params.description: Window start in seconds within the source (default: 0)

params.name: duration
params.description: Window duration in seconds within the source (default: rest of the file)
